title: RevocationRequest
description: Request to revoke one principal's sessions (PRP-39; PRP-06 revocation service). The target principal is named by the route, never by this body. issued_before: deny every token issued at or before the revocation (plus clock skew); the principal may sign in again. until_lifted: deny every token until an operator lifts the revocation. Revocation is bounded by NS_REVOCATION_TTL_SECONDS, not instant.
